purpose: Maps the Checkov checks that Verdet et al. (2025) ran on 401 AWS Terraform projects onto our validator rules, so their October 2022 results can serve as a real-world human baseline.

evidence_levels.checkov-source: Check ID, name and resource type read in Checkov's source code (github.com/bridgecrewio/checkov)
evidence_levels.policy-description: Taken from Verdet et al.'s policy file; baseline.py prints the description so it can be confirmed after download

policy_descriptions_confirmed.by: python -m dataset.baseline --show-policies against policies-aws-final.csv at commit 4fd6c747c7fb9d8d4fb2734f4e4da423e128f17d
policy_descriptions_confirmed.result: All six policy-description mappings match their rule.
quirks_without_effect: Row POL48 (an SQS queue CMK policy) lists CKV_AWS_3 in its Checkov column; results.csv counts by Checkov ID, and CKV_AWS_3 is the EBS check in Checkov's source.
CKV_AWS_16 carries tfsec's 'RDS Cluster' wording in their file; Checkov's source shows it checks aws_db_instance.

WS-06.note: Related, not identical: CKV_AWS_3 covers stand-alone aws_ebs_volume resources and CKV_AWS_8 launch-configuration volumes; our rule covers a server's root disk.

ST-01.note: Block Public Access switches and presence of a public access block. Their scan did not include restrict_public_buckets (CKV_AWS_56).

ST-02.note: S3 server-side encryption at rest (any key type, like our rule).

ST-04.note: S3 server access logging enabled (Checkov does not check which target bucket).

excluded_checks.CKV_AWS_260: Port 80 open to 0.0.0.0/0 (checked in Checkov's source). Our web-server tasks require HTTP to be open (WS-04), so counting it as an error would inflate the human error rate.
excluded_checks.CKV_AWS_181: Requires a customer-managed KMS key; stricter than ST-02.
excluded_checks.CKV_AWS_189: Requires a customer-managed KMS key for EBS; stricter than WS-06.
excluded_checks.CKV2_AWS_2: Not verified against Checkov's source; left out rather than guessed.

not_covered.WS-03: RDP check (CKV_AWS_25) was not in their scan
not_covered.ST-03: S3 versioning check was not in their scan
not_covered.DB-02: no database-port check in their scan
not_covered.DB-05: backup retention check was not in their scan
